assets.authority_source: backend CMS PersonalityPublicContentAsset and public comparison API
evidence: The current backend authority contains exactly seven published zh-CN cross-type comparison records: enfp-vs-entp, entj-vs-intj, estj-vs-entj, infj-vs-infp, intj-vs-intp, isfp-vs-infp, and istj-vs-isfj.
Read-only live checks returned 200 for every zh-CN page/API pair and 404 for every English page/API pair.
The dedicated MbtiCrossTypeComparisonAuthority model is the current storage authority; its public read model is explicitly restricted to zh-CN.
assets.notes: All seven English assets are absent, not drafts or route-only shells. The master authority label is retained as a protected field even though the current implementation uses a dedicated comparison authority table rather than PersonalityPublicContentAsset.
